scope: Exact separately reviewable schema implementation candidate for the D15 lossless embedded-Uncertainty policy. This candidate changes the non-authoritative v0.2 schema/fixtures on its branch but does not migrate or modify authoritative v0.1 knowledge objects.

exact_design.schema_version_rationale: No authoritative v0.2 objects exist; v0.2 remains an implementation candidate during the compatibility phase, so repairing its embedded record shape does not require introducing a second implicit v0.2 type-schema version.

reopening_or_reduction_conditions.rationale: v0.1 what_would_reduce_it is an ordered array with minItems 1 and does not require uniqueness. Adding deduplication would reject or transform schema-valid legacy state.

status.rationale: The exact v0.1 uncertainty lifecycle vocabulary is accepted directly so legacy state can be preserved without inventing a mapping. This candidate does not add new embedded-Uncertainty lifecycle meanings.

compatibility_strategy.rationale: The repository has no authoritative v0.2 objects. A compatibility union would preserve only test-fixture history while creating two valid uncertainty shapes and additional ambiguity. Historical research/proof snapshots remain preserved as historical files instead.

deterministic_v01_mapping.question: text verbatim
deterministic_v01_mapping.what_would_reduce_it: reopening_or_reduction_conditions verbatim as the same ordered array
deterministic_v01_mapping.uncertainty_record_count: one legacy uncertainty remains one embedded uncertainty

implementation_scope: tests proving exact lossless mapping and rejection of the superseded v0.2 uncertainty shape
historical-snapshot regression tests made forward-compatible where they previously froze the pre-D15 schema

historical_snapshot_policy.reason: Historical files continue to describe the schema and decision state at the time they were prepared.

decision_candidate.question: Accept the exact D15 embedded-Uncertainty schema implementation candidate: neutral text, canonical plural reopening_or_reduction_conditions array preserving order and duplicates, direct legacy status vocabulary with identity-only mapping, and no compatibility union?
decision_candidate.recommended_action: Accept the exact implementation candidate only. If accepted, record the acceptance as D16 against the unchanged protected base, update the paired candidate from schema-implementation-pending to schema-implementation-accepted, revalidate the new exact head, and then present a guarded merge gate.
